We’re extending the 50% increase to weekly Claude Code limits through August 31. 

We hope to make this a permanent change to our plans, but strong demand for our models means that capacity may be tight over the coming weeks. We’ll keep you posted as things develop. https://t.co/ymCyQH5ADT
